tools.name: practice_decision
tools.description: Get one real clinical research decision from CRLN's public Practice Lab scenarios: the situation, the question and the options, with no answer. tools.name: check_answer
tools.description: Score the person's choice for a CRLN practice decision. Returns the score out of 4, the feedback, the rule it rests on and a link to continue that scenario in CRLN. It never says which option is best. Call it only after the person has chosen.

tools.name: explain_rule
tools.description: Plain-language answer from CRLN's published pages to a question about ICH E6(R3), Good Clinical Practice, US FDA rules for site staff, free GCP training, clinical research careers, or taking part in research, with the primary sources cited and a link straight to the page. tools.name: career_path
tools.description: For a clinical research role and a country, link to CRLN's Career Path Finder page for that role and country, plus free training for it.

tools.name: site_readiness_info
tools.description: What CRLN's free Site Portal does for clinical research sites (training records, staff readiness, a readiness record for sponsors), with a link. It cannot see or change any site's data.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "practice_decision" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Get one real clinical research decision from CRLN's public Practice Lab scenarios: the situation, the question and the options, with no answer. Optional role fi…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
